records.detail: REAR02 targeted ownership correction: preserve the existing black-wrapped high topknot at currentx517,y85 and whole body-behind long hair curtain. WIDEN and fill the posterior side hair continuously on BOTH sides of the back of the head, with the male reference's swept-back layered strand groups. The REAR layer must extend as a fully pigmented continuous mass across the hidden head interior and over the entire ear-behind zones: leftx370-410,y345-445 and rightx625-660,y345-445. The fixed ears from Image4 will cover these parts at composition time. Do not paint ears into the hair. No gaps, pale transparent shell, ear notches, front fringe or forehead hairline. Connect these fuller side wings naturally to the back scalp above and the neck-back curtain below. This is behind-ear hair, so the entire hair mass under the separate ear should be opaque dark hair with natural details, not see-through.
